meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Guides a refactor, cleanup, or restructure with the right decomposition. Use when the user asks to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把杂乱难懂的代码拆解重组成清晰结构,让它更易读易改
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有写乱或过时的代码想理清结构又不想改变行为
copy.tagline_en: Break messy code into a clearer structure without changing what it does
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your code feels tangled and you want cleaner structure without behavior changes

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把重构当固定流程执行:先确认目标和范围,扫描代码依赖与测试覆盖,出分步计划,再逐步修改;每步改完跑测试和类型检查,不通过就停下修,不盲目批量替换。
howto.when: 当你要求重构、简化、抽取或现代化代码,或输入 /refactor 并给出目标时接管;若目标含糊(如只说「清理一下」),它会先反问具体想改什么、范围是哪些文件。

say.text: 把校验逻辑抽成单独的模块
say.note: 它先问范围,再扫描依赖出计划

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude runs refactoring as a fixed procedure: confirm the goal and scope, scan dependencies and test coverage, produce a step-by-step plan, then edit step by step. After each step it runs tests and type checks, stopping to fix failures instead of blind search-and-replace.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code, or run /refactor with a target. If the goal is vague (e.g. "just clean up"), it first asks what exactly to improve and which files or modules are in scope.

say_en.note: Touches only this file, safe strategy by default
Checks test coverage before allowing wider changes

say_en.text: Extract the validation logic into its own module
say_en.note: It asks scope, then maps dependencies and plans
